name: ironwallengraving.com
description: Production CloudFront distribution for the public storefront. Cloudflare DNS points the production domain at this distribution. It serves the frontend from the private S3 site bucket, product/post images from the same bucket, and /api/* requests from the HTTP API origin. The distribution uses the site-directory-index CloudFront Function on viewer requests and the CloudFront-scoped WAF ACL named CreatedByCloudFront-cdf7dc89.

origins.description: Default frontend origin. Requests are served from the site/ prefix in the bucket.
Image origin for images/* requests. Product and post images are served from the bucket root-relative images/ prefix.
